name: HMCALL
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | Cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses and profit before tax: Haldane McCall Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, N'000. Revenue, gross profit, cost of sales, administrative expenses and operating profit from the statement of comprehensive income, printed page 36 (file _ngx_pdf/HMCALL.pdf page index 35); profit before tax and profit for the year confirmed on the directors' report operating result table, printed page 11. The statement prints a nil finance cost line.
